messages:
edr-bot: EDR alert — Suspicious execution chain on host mbp-jw-21 (user: jamie). Quarantine applied: /private/var/tmp/jet_helper.bin. Detection ID: EDR-2100-ABC123. Network fetch to https://cdn.thirdparty.dev/payload.
jamie: I installed a JetBrains plugin a few minutes ago (ThemesPlus). Laptop got slow, then that popup. I closed the IDE. :grimacing:
priya: thanks — don't reboot or power off yet. Priya from SecOps taking point. Can you disconnect from corp VPN and stop using external drives?
jamie: unplugged VPN, unplugging USB now.
samir: grabbed the artifact and live process tree. Uploading bundle to /opt/sec/artifacts/EDR-2100-ABC123.zip now. Running yara and strings quick scan.
priya: quick triage: payload looks like a small downloader that drops a signed helper and then spawns a PowerShell one-liner to fetch a payload. Example observed: `powershell -nop -w hidden -c "[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('...')) | iex"`
leo: question for infra — EDR quarantine blobs are encrypted; do we have a documented KMS/CMK policy for exporting a blob for offline forensics? We may need to hand it to our DFIR vendor. @security-infra
security-infra: current flow: EDR agent encrypts with vendor-managed key tied to org account. We can request a key unwrap/transfer, but that requires a signed request and approval.
samir: to make forensics actionable, I need the raw binary decrypted. Can we get a short-lived RBAC grant for `quarantine:export` to the sec-forensics group?
priya: temporary access OK with two conditions: 1) create ticket and include justification, 2) all actions are logged and pushed to Splunk index `sec_audit`. I'll open the ticket.
leo: created ticket SEC-3421 and added initial notes + artifacts path. Linking ticket in slack.
jamie: what are next steps for my laptop — reimage?
priya: likely reimage. We'll snapshot logs, collect any creds in memory if possible, then schedule reimage with IT. For now keep it off any non-corp networks.
security-infra: approved short-lived role `quarantine-exporter` for samir for 2 hours — will produce an audit event `edr.quarantine.export` with requestor and ticket id.
samir: exporting blob now, running local decryption flow. Found second-stage URL and SHA256: `d6f1c2...a9b3`. Yara hit matches RAT family X-Loader.
priya: ok — escalate to incident response (low-medium severity). Notify DFIR vendor, disable any ephemeral tokens jamie used, rotate SSH keys for jamie and check Git auth.
jamie: I used my personal GitHub token in IntelliJ once last week; do we need to revoke it?
priya: yes — rotate any tokens you used on that host. We'll add steps to ticket.
leo: post-incident actions: 1) add ThemesPlus to blocked plugin list until vendor verifies, 2) update onboarding docs to warn about marketplace plugins, 3) verify EDR KMS export runbook for faster turns.
priya: I'll follow up with a short post-incident checklist and assign owners. Samir — please attach decrypted blob and yara results to SEC-3421.
samir: done. uploaded to ticket and S3 forensic bucket (secured). Added Splunk events for every access.
jamie: thanks everyone. I'll await reimage schedule.
priya: final note: create psa to engineering: avoid 3rd-party plugins or use only preapproved ones. We'll coordinate messaging after IT completes reimage.
